newsitem.title: USA: Missouri university mulls bond issue for arena.
newsitem.headline: Missouri university mulls bond issue for arena.

text.p: The University of Missouri Curators board may consider a bond issue to help finance a $45 million to $50 million arena for the University of Missouri at Columbia, a university spokesman said Monday.

Dave Lendt said the university already has recieved a $10 million donation for the facility and may seek further donations. He said the 17,000-seat basketball arena could be financed with a mix of donated funds and tax-exempt bond proceeds.

However, a financing plan is not currently on the table for the board. At its meeting earlier this month, the board selected Kansas City-based Ellerbe Beckett as the architertual firm for the project, Lendt said.
The university hopes to have the arena ready for the 1999-2000 season, he added.
